# Audit 01 — Security

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `056411883b505c4b2fb7ab2e2604e37253514d8a` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` = `a00803b5947b7f52e18537e46edab86a949331da` (source digest of `app/ routes/ config/ database/ resources/ bootstrap/ public/index.php composer.*` on the host equals the tag tree; the two commits differ only in `.github/docs/**` and `CHANGELOG.md`).

Scope: authentication, session handling, CSRF, login throttling, workspace isolation, input validation, output escaping, unsafe URLs, secret handling, private/demo separation, dependency advisories, release integrity, effective host configuration. Host evidence is sanitized: no hostnames, credentials, identifiers or opportunity content are reproduced.

## Confirmed defects (by severity)

| ID     | Sev  | Location                                                                                                                                                                           | Finding                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Impact                                                                                                                   | Smallest corrective action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------ | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SEC-01 | Low  | [routes/web.php](../../../routes/web.php#L29-L30)                                                                                                                                  | `POST /logout` is registered inside the `['auth', 'review.workspace']` group. An authenticated user whose `workspace_id` is null receives 403 from `EnsureReviewWorkspace` and cannot terminate the session (only expiry after `SESSION_LIFETIME=120` ends it). `ReviewAuthenticationTest` covers logout only for an assigned user.                                     | A mis-provisioned or de-assigned account keeps a live session it cannot end.                                             | Register `/logout` under `auth` only (outside the `review.workspace` group) and add one test for the unassigned case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| SEC-02 | Low  | [database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php](../../../database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php#L19-L22), [database/factories/UserFactory.php](../../../database/factories/UserFactory.php#L31) | The default seeder (target of `php artisan db:seed` / `migrate --seed`) creates `test@example.com` with the factory's shared password `password` and no environment/mode guard. Not referenced by app code, tests or CI. **Primary finding**; its scaffold-leftover aspect is cross-referenced (not counted again) as LEG-02 in [07-legacy-code.md](07-legacy-code.md). | An operator mistake on a real database creates a guessable login (no workspace, so no data access, but a valid session). | Delete `DatabaseSeeder::run()` body or guard it with `app()->environment('local')`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| SEC-03 | Low  | Host response headers (`GET /login`, `GET /opportunities`)                                                                                                                         | No `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`/CSP `frame-ancestors` or `Referrer-Policy` header is emitted by the application or the reverse proxy. HTTP→HTTPS 301 works; cookies are `secure; httponly; samesite=lax`.                                                                                                                   | Browser hardening only; no exploit path identified given CSRF + SameSite + Vue text rendering.                           | Add the four headers via the hosting panel/`public/.htaccess` or one tiny middleware. Not a release blocker.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| SEC-04 | Low  | Host `.env` (`LOG_LEVEL=debug`, `LOG_CHANNEL=stack`→`single`); `storage/logs/laravel.log` mode `0644`, 482 KB, unrotated                                                           | Production logs at `debug`. The four recorded `production.ERROR` entries (2026-09-22, demo-database setup) are framework `QueryException`s whose message includes the DB host and database name (Laravel default). The application itself never logs (grep: zero `Log::`/`report()` in `app/`). Counts of `password`/mailbox keys/e-mail addresses in the log: 0.       | Low: file is inside a `0700` home directory; leakage is limited to connection metadata.                                  | Switch to the `daily` channel and `chmod 0600` the log to limit exposure and growth. Note: raising `LOG_LEVEL` to `warning` reduces noise but **still records** `ERROR`-level `QueryException` messages, and rotation/permissions do not sanitize exception contents. Redacting SQL/connection metadata would require an explicit exception-reporting decision (e.g. a `report` callback), which is optional and out of this audit's scope. |
| SEC-05 | Info | Host `.env`                                                                                                                                                                        | `OPPORTUNITY_MAILBOX_ENABLED=false` appears twice (both `false`; last value wins).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | None today; a future edit of only one line would be silently ignored.                                                    | Remove the duplicate line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

## Accepted limitations (documented, not defects)

- `MailboxConfiguration` disables the TLS/cert-validation guard when `APP_ENV=testing` ([MailboxConfiguration.php](../../../app/Domain/Mailbox/Data/MailboxConfiguration.php#L36-L38)); production is `APP_ENV=production` (verified).
- STARTTLS (`tls`) mode is pinned to TLS 1.2 by the vendor package; implicit TLS (`ssl`) negotiates freely. Mailbox intake is currently disabled, so neither path is live.
- `/up` (framework health route) is public and returns 200 with no application data.
- Shared demo is a shared synthetic session by design; presets are server-resolved ([StoreOpportunityEnrichmentRequest.php](../../../app/Http/Requests/Review/StoreOpportunityEnrichmentRequest.php#L26-L31)).
- The canonical listing link is validated server-side only (`^https://www\.upwork\.com/jobs/~\d+$`, [OpportunityDetailResource.php](../../../app/Http/Resources/Review/OpportunityDetailResource.php#L103-L109)) and rendered with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; the client trusts the resource.
- The Syft checksum file is fetched from the same GitHub release as the binary (not independently pinned) — see [ci.yml](../../../.github/workflows/ci.yml#L226-L235).

## Optional improvements

- Coverage artifact `phpunit-coverage-clover` uploads on PRs with default retention ([ci.yml](../../../.github/workflows/ci.yml#L255-L260)); add `if: github.event_name == 'push'` and `retention-days`.
- `.gitignore` lists `.env`, `.env.demo`, `.env.testing`, `.env.backup`, `.env.production` individually; a generic `.env.*` + `!.env.*.example` pattern would prevent a future `.env.staging` commit.
- Consider `SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true` explicitly in the private `.env` (currently inferred; observed `secure` flag present).

## Review limits

Vendored dependencies were assessed through lockfiles, `composer audit`, `npm audit` and the published SBOM, not by reading vendor code (except `webklex/php-imap` protocol internals relevant to credential/debug handling). Hosting-panel settings (PHP pool, WAF rules, TLS termination) were not inspectable. Rate limiting and the authenticated journey were not exercised on the host.
